title: Mob Drop Randomizer
description: Replace vanilla mob drops with fully configurable randomized loot featuring categories, rarities, weighted drop chances, presets, and live in-game configuration.
body:
# 🎲 Mob Drop Randomizer

Transform Minecraft's predictable mob drops into a fully configurable randomized loot system.

Every mob can drop random items from a global loot pool, complete with configurable rarity weighting, categories, presets, and live in-game configuration.

---

# ✨ Features

- 🎲 Fully randomized mob drops
- 💎 Five rarity tiers
- ⚖️ Weighted rarity selection
- 📦 Category filtering
- 🔄 Runtime configuration reloads
- 🎛️ Interactive in-game dashboard
- ✨ Automatic rarity tooltips
- 📈 Configurable mob-specific drop counts
- 🚀 Optimized item registry caching
- 🛠️ Built-in gameplay presets

---

# 📋 Commands

```text
/mobdrop

/mobdrop stats
/mobdrop categories
/mobdrop rarities
/mobdrop chances

/mobdrop preset <preset>

/mobdrop reload
```

---

# ⚙️ Configuration

Everything can be configured without restarting Minecraft.

- Enable or disable item categories
- Enable or disable rarity tiers
- Adjust weighted rarity chances
- Configure mob drop amounts
- Apply built-in presets instantly

---

# 🚧 Planned Features

- Interactive graphical configuration menu
- Additional gameplay modifiers
- More preset options
- Expanded loot customization

---

# 📦 Requirements

- Minecraft 1.21.1
- Fabric Loader
- Fabric API
- Java 21
